title: I love the way this duvet cover fits
text: I love the way this duvet cover fits. I put this set on my queen bed and used it without a duvet.  I loved it!  It's so soft and adds just enough warmth for S. La.  The colors are great and it washes well.  No pilling after 2 washes.
